content.title: Why Analysts See Capri Holdings Story Shifting Amid Turnaround Hopes And Lingering Risks

This modest recalibration suggests that recent strategic moves and shifting analyst sentiment are nudging the long term narrative in a more constructive direction, even without a major reset to top line expectations.
